allow: PowerShell(Write-Output "=== Git installed? ==="; git --version; Write-Output "`n=== Existing SSH keys ==="; if \(Test-Path "$env:USERPROFILE\\.ssh"\) { Get-ChildItem "$env:USERPROFILE\\.ssh" | Select-Object Name } else { Write-Output "No .ssh directory" }; Write-Output "`n=== Is current dir a git repo? ==="; if \(Test-Path ".git"\) { Write-Output "Yes"; git remote -v } else { Write-Output "No .git here" })

PowerShell(if \(-not \(Test-Path "$env:USERPROFILE\\.ssh"\)\) { New-Item -ItemType Directory "$env:USERPROFILE\\.ssh" | Out-Null }; ssh-keygen -t ed25519 -C "ramoness614@gmail.com" -f "$env:USERPROFILE\\.ssh\\id_ed25519" -N '""'; Write-Output "`n=== Done. Public key below ===")

PowerShell(Set-Service ssh-agent -StartupType Manual -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Start-Service ssh-agent -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; ssh-add "$env:USERPROFILE\\.ssh\\id_ed25519"; Write-Output "`n=== COPY THIS PUBLIC KEY ==="; Get-Content "$env:USERPROFILE\\.ssh\\id_ed25519.pub")

PowerShell(Write-Output "=== Archive size ==="; Get-ChildItem "DashboardLKPDNTBlocal.tar.gz" | Select-Object Name, @{N='MB';E={[math]::Round\($_.Length/1MB,1\)}}; Write-Output "`n=== node_modules present? ==="; Get-ChildItem -Recurse -Directory -Filter node_modules -Depth 2 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object FullName; Write-Output "`n=== existing .gitignore? ==="; if \(Test-Path ".gitignore"\) { "yes" } else { "no" }; Write-Output "`n=== frontend contents ==="; Get-ChildItem "frontend" -Force | Select-Object Name)
